tldr: The public causal log-event-time slope model has unknown smooth event and censoring laws, unknown bounded dense heteroscedasticity directions, and actual multinomial counts. Its original-record all-estimator minimax risk satisfies \(R_n\to R^\dagger\). The explicit data-only map \(\check\beta_n\) attains this limit uniformly over the entire declared class, including changing profiles, coalescing covariance types, scalar and strength boundaries, and random counts. Terminating rational inner and outer certificates compute \(R^\dagger\), the worst pointwise normalized influence-function benchmark \(D_{\max}\), and the exact positive learning price \(\mathfrak P=R^\dagger-D_{\max}\). No true nuisance, covariance, direction, strength, strength ratio, rotation, or fixed count is an estimator input.
